text_block_list.text:
Having finished her three years in the 
Twinkle Series, Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi now 
stands—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Kieeeeeee!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Waaah!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I see it! I can see it clearly! To put it 
simply, what Tsurumaru-san's Trainer is 
thinking is—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Fortune-telling is so fascinating! Maybe 
I should try it too!" —This is it! Nailed 
it, didn't I!?

text_block_list.name: Fukukitaru & Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Waaaah?!

Escaping from the suspicious shack, she 
and Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi bask in the 
sunlight.
choice_data_list: Why fortune-telling all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Huh? That's... umm.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
To put it bluntly! Trainer-san, are you 
feeling anxious about our future!?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Right?!! I completely agree with you!!

I tilt my head at behavior far too bizarre 
even for her. She claims she has no 
worries, but could there actually be a 
problem she's hiding...?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, everything looks completely normal to 
me~
choice_data_list: So you were healthy all along!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Well, of course, Trainer! I told you I'd 
be fine!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Ho-ho-ho~. Trainer, Tsurumaru-san must be 
more precious to you than anything else.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Heh... Hehehe. Even so, seriously now~.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Ho-ho-ho... By the way, Trainer? Your 
accompanying sessions for training next 
week were on Wednesday and Friday, 
correct?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
And I'm running in a race this weekend! I 
request that you accompany me!

—Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi continues to run with 
high spirits in the Twinkle Series to this 
day.

Even on the racetracks where the new 
generation was on the rise, she made her 
presence known as a pillar of the Golden 
Generation.

By continuing to run, she keeps showing 
everyone the "possibilities" ahead.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
And what's more, at the end of next month! 
We've got the race against Spe-chan and 
the others!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes. El Condor Pasa and Grass Wonder 
were coming over there too, right~?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Yes! She said she won't give up the title 
of the strongest! It's a rematch!
choice_data_list: Oh, then I'll have to win, won't I?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... that's right~! The title of the 
strongest belongs to me!
(CLATTER-RATTLE!)

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Teach! Look at my legs............—

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
—!? M-Mom!? Awesome! The "Emperor's 
Successor" is right there!

text_block_list.name: Boy's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry, my child just...! Hey! You 
aren't supposed to enter the consultation 
room until called, right?!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
N-No, no! I'm the one who stayed too 
long...!

I bow politely and leave the examination 
room. Together with the "Empress's 
Incarnation."
choice_data_list:
...They say she's the "Successor to the 
Emperor."

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...Apparently that's what people are 
saying.

Through a moment at the Arima Kinen, her 
relationship with Symboli Rudolf became 
known across generations.

"It received massive coverage on 
television as well, and what it came to be 
named was—"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ……"Successor to the Emperor".

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Hyaaa~~, it still feels tickly! To carry 
the "Emperor" on my back—"

The boy who entered the examination room 
just moments ago is gazing at Tsurumaru 
Tsuyoshi with shining eyes...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ............ Do you play sports too?

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I got hurt, but I'm not giving up! 
I'm gonna give it everything I've got, 
just like Kesho-sha!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ...! Sounds great!

With a carefree smile on her face, 
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi gently patted the boy's 
head.

Health. Rivalry with her peers. The 
caliber to succeed the "Emperor." She has 
gained so many possibilities up until now.

Surrounded by so much happiness right now, 
there's no way I could harbor any anxiety 
about the future.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —No, I really don't measure up after all.

On the way home from the hospital, 
Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi's sudden words make me 
turn back instinctively.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"Because I'm getting way too much all to 
myself! None of this was something I could 
have achieved alone!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"...Isn't there anything you want, 
Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Like, maybe you want more prestigious 
achievements! In that case, I'll aim to 
become Umamusume of the Year next season!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Tsuyoshi can do anything right now! I can 
make whatever you wish for come true!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Please give me your honest opinion~! I 
want to know what I can offer in return!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"And after I even relied on 
Fukukitaru-san's fortune telling, too..."
choice_data_list:
(So that's why she did that mysterious 
fortune-telling!?)

text_block_list.text:
A chuckle wells up seeing her spin her 
wheels. ...When there's really only one 
thing I want her to do for me.
choice_data_list:
Then I want you to stay healthy and 
energetic forever.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Is that all?
choice_data_list: Then I can keep cheering you on forever!
Then I can keep cheering you on forever!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"...Are you sure that's all right? 
Besides, it feels like once again, good 
things are only happening to me..."
choice_data_list:
No, making that come true is going to be 
tough.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: "...Ehh? Is that so~?"

By moving forward in her own true way, 
there are people who continuously draw 
courage and hope from her.

Even if she didn't notice. Even if she 
couldn't achieve a glorious victory like 
last year's.

"—Because the 'absolute' legacy she carved 
will remain in this world forever."
